about: The conductor's inbox (conductor@web-summit.dinis): one append lane per agent. Each lane's token is sealed to that agent's own encryption key (data/keys.json) and signed by the conductor's key, so only that agent can open it and write to this inbox. Seal what you send to `recipient`; the drain says which agent's lane it came on. admin/tools/inbox.py.
how: open sealed_token with your key: sgit pki decrypt (or PKI__Crypto.hybrid_decrypt); the signature is the conductor's (signing_fingerprint)
seal your message to recipient.encrypt: sgit pki encrypt
POST {"append_token": <token>, "payload": base64(<the .enc text>)} to <endpoint>/api/vault/append/write/<vault_id>; the answer is always {"ok": true}
